## Change and scope

Describe the problem, resulting statement or behavior, and affected claims and consumers. State whether this changes mathematics, evidence, computation, documentation or infrastructure.

## Review evidence

Follow the [contributor review guide](https://github.com/elliotglazer/diophantine-z-q/blob/main/docs/research-review/README.md). Link evidence for each applicable item; explain any item that does not apply. Do not mark incomplete work as accepted.

- Exact revision, proposed edits and affected claims:
- Published theorems applied, with the version read and the hypothesis and convention comparisons:
- Explicit construction or computational specification, certificates, reproduction commands and results:
- Reviews received: who or what reviewed which revision, and what they concluded:
- All received audits and findings, their resolutions and remaining objections:
- For an official new record: complete current `.tex` project and matching `.pdf`, with the improvement and necessary project arguments incorporated. A short proposal may leave integration pending, but must not promote the official record before these requirements are met:

## Validation and limits

List checks run, their results and what they establish. Report `python -B scripts/check_audit_history.py --self-test` when relevant. Identify unrun checks and unresolved assumptions.

Check the live [public ruleset](https://github.com/elliotglazer/diophantine-z-q/rules/26781429) for current enforcement. The private repository has no ruleset. Green CI alone does not certify a proof.
